summary: Q1 revise-apply resolved all four 131-review-apply Blocking Findings by making every production-reachable result-admission / immutable-ref / non-Run-resolver / verification-recovery boundary fail closed. (Q1-RA-006) C1 terminal result admission is now a shared two-phase pipeline: admitC1RunResult (validateRunResultFileCombination + validateActionResultWithoutRunRef + validateReviewVerdictIntegrity) must pass BEFORE any formal fact is promoted, and a review whose exact binding (reviewedRunId ↔ inputRef target ↔ actual bytes) is broken or whose result fails the closed schema is NOT admitted into snapshot.reviewVerdicts and therefore cannot be consumed as lineage by generation classification; review-entry sibling lineage (readRunVerdict) applies the same full admission + binding proof. Non-ENOENT result read failures now surface a run-result FactConflict instead of silently projecting pending. (Q1-RA-007) validateImmutableRunResultRefs strictly validates non-review inputRef, consumedInputRefs[*] and reviewVerdictRef for kind == run-result, Core-allowed canonical target reconstruction from the embedded Run ID, target existence/readability, and actual SHA-256; reviewVerdictRef must also exact-match context.sourceReviewRun/result.json and sourceReviewVerdict must match the referenced review Run's actual admitted verdict. The validation is independent of mutable generation class — superseded and revision-window generations remain strictly validated. (Q1-RA-008) normalizeArtifactLogicalRef rejects POSIX absolute (leading /) and Windows drive-letter evidence BEFORE normalization; assertCanonicalArtifactRoot enforces the exact openspec/changes/<changeId>/ root identity plus no traversal and non-result.json targets; resolveArchiveAwareArtifactPath asserts the canonical root at entry; archive discovery accepts ONLY the exact YYYY-MM-DD-<changeId> grammar with a real calendar date (malformed/suffix-match dirs never match), and active + exact archive ambiguity fails closed. (Q1-RA-009) current review-apply verificationSummaryRef is four-layer fail-closed: missing actionResult/summary-ref/malformed → conflict; kind must be verification-summary; logical ref must exactly equal the Core-derived openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md; archive-aware physical resolution + current-bytes SHA-256 match, with missing/ambiguous/replacement each producing a FactConflict; legitimate changes-requested → revise-apply superseded verification generations do not regress (Q1-9). Regression: Q1-RA-001 / RA-003 / RA-005 remain resolved. All verification checks were actually executed and passed: typecheck, lint, build, 542 tests (542 pass, 0 fail), OpenSpec change strict, 8/8 canonical specs strict, git diff --check. Delivery Full Test was NOT run (no authorization for revise-apply). No contract artifacts, prior Runs, or Flowkit state were modified; no Git commit was created by this Run.

resolvedFindings.evidence: Shared C1 terminal-result admission pipeline: src/persistence/serialization.ts now exports admitC1RunResult(raw, action) which runs validateRunResultFileCombination + validateActionResultWithoutRunRef + validateReviewVerdictIntegrity and returns a typed RunResultFile or throws SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED. src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts readC1Run uses it as Phase-1 admission (run-result-schema / run-result-status conflicts on failure; verdict is constructed ONLY after admission passes), and src/persistence/run-persistence.ts readRunVerdict uses the same pipeline plus context inputRef exact-binding proof before a verdict may enter sibling review lineage. validateReviewExactBindings now returns { conflicts, admittedVerdicts } — a review with broken target/hash binding or a terminal review without inputRef is reported AND its verdict is dropped from admittedReviewVerdicts, so generation classification never consumes it. Non-ENOENT result read failures (e.g. EISDIR) produce a run-result FactConflict instead of projecting pending. Negative tests: closed-schema-violating review (blockingFindings field) → no ReviewVerdictFact + run-result-schema conflict; changes-requested without blocking findings → no ReviewVerdictFact; wrong-fingerprint inputRef → review-binding-mismatch + verdict not admitted; C1 review without inputRef → review-binding-missing + not admitted; EISDIR result.json → run-result conflict; integration: closed-schema-violating historical review and binding-broken review cannot open a legitimate supersession lineage.

validateImmutableRunResultRefs (src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts) runs after review exact bindings and BEFORE mutable-artifact generation classification, so a tampered immutable ref can never hide behind a healthy mutable artifact set. For non-review inputRef, consumedInputRefs[*] and reviewVerdictRef it enforces: kind === 'run-result'; canonical target reconstruction via resolveRunResultPath(runsPathPrefix, deliveryId, changeId, embeddedRunId) compared against the ref (immutable-ref-target on mismatch); target existence/readability (immutable-ref-missing); actual content SHA-256 vs versionFingerprint (immutable-ref-mismatch). For reviewVerdictRef it additionally requires the embedded Run ID to equal context.sourceReviewRun and sourceReviewVerdict to equal the referenced review Run's actual admitted verdict (immutable-ref-target / immutable-ref-verdict-mismatch). RunFact now carries consumedInputRefs and reviewVerdictRef (formal-fact-snapshot.ts). Negative tests: wrong kind (rejected at schema admission), missing target, path-shaped target (../../result.json), fingerprint mismatch, and integration test proving a SUPERSEDED generation's tampered reviewVerdictRef still produces immutable-ref-mismatch (no supersession exemption).

src/persistence/result-ref-adapter.ts normalizeArtifactLogicalRef now rejects POSIX absolute (separatorNormalized.startsWith('/')) and Windows drive-letter evidence BEFORE the leading-'/' strip, so /openspec/changes/C1/proposal.md and C:\openspec\...\proposal.md are rejected instead of silently rewritten. New assertCanonicalArtifactRoot enforces the exact openspec/changes/<changeId>/... root identity (rejects docs/proposal.md, openspec/changes//proposal.md, traversal, empty trailing file, result.json targets). resolveArchiveAwareArtifactPath asserts the canonical root at entry. Archive discovery uses new changeIdFromArchiveDirectoryName which accepts ONLY the exact YYYY-MM-DD-<changeId> grammar AND validates the date is a real calendar date (rejects 2026-13-99-C1, 2026-02-30-C1, 2026-2-02-C1); findArchiveMatches now filters by exact changeId equality instead of endsWith('-<changeId>'), so 2026-02-02-C1-extra / C1 / 2026-02-02 never match. active + multiple exact archive dirs fail closed. Negative tests cover all of the above (POSIX absolute, Windows absolute, traversal, wrong root, empty changeId, result.json target, malformed archive names, suffix-match bypass closed, active+exact-archive ambiguity).

validateCurrentVerificationSummaryRef (src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts) is now fail-closed for every current review-apply generation: missing actionResult or missing verificationSummaryRef → verification-summary-missing; malformed (non-string ref/versionFingerprint) → verification-summary-malformed; kind !== VERIFICATION_SUMMARY_KIND → verification-summary-kind; logical ref !== resolveVerificationSummaryRef(run.changeId) (Core-derived openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md) → verification-summary-path; archive-aware physical resolution missing/ambiguous → verification-summary-missing / verification-summary-archive-ambiguous; current bytes SHA-256 !== versionFingerprint → verification-summary-replaced. validateVerificationGenerationAware still classifies superseded (legitimate changes-requested → revise-apply exact lineage) generations as skipped, so Q1-9 legitimate supersession behavior does not regress. Negative tests cover missing, malformed, wrong-kind (rejected at schema admission), wrong-path, missing-target (dedicated changeId without verification.md), and fingerprint-mismatch paths; integration tests confirm legitimate superseded verificationSummaryRef produces no false conflict and no-lineage verification.md replacement fails closed.
